+# --- Patch for RequestValidationError ---
+original_request_validation_str = RequestValidationError.__str__
+
+def patched_request_validation_str(self) -> str:
+    context = getattr(self, 'endpoint_context', None)
+    if context:
+        # Format:
+        # fastapi.exceptions.RequestValidationError: 1 validation error: ...
+        #
+        #   File "/path/to/file.py", line 43, in create_item
+        #     POST /items/
+        return f"{original_request_validation_str(self)}\n\n  File \"{context['filepath']}\", line {context['line_number']}, in {context['function_name']}\n    {context['http_method']} {context['route']}"
+    return original_request_validation_str(self)
+
+RequestValidationError.__str__ = patched_request_validation_str
+
+# --- Patch for WebSocketRequestValidationError ---
+original_websocket_request_validation_str = WebSocketRequestValidationError.__str__
+
+def patched_websocket_request_validation_str(self) -> str:
+    context = getattr(self, 'endpoint_context', None)
+    if context:
+        # Format:
+        # fastapi.exceptions.WebSocketRequestValidationError: 1 validation error: ...
+        #
+        #   File "/path/to/file.py", line 48, in websocket_endpoint
+        #     WS /ws/{item_id}
+        return f"{original_websocket_request_validation_str(self)}\n\n  File \"{context['filepath']}\", line {context['line_number']}, in {context['function_name']}\n    WS {context['route']}"
+    return original_websocket_request_validation_str(self)
+
+WebSocketRequestValidationError.__str__ = patched_websocket_request_validation_str
